verdict.rationale: uv is a CLI-first tool with an official `astral-sh/setup-uv` GitHub Action that installs it, adds it to PATH, persists the cache, and supports Python version matrices. It also offers machine-readable output (`uv version --output-format json`) and a documented CLI reference. Hands-on reports corroborate CI use: a user replaced about 10 lines of CI YAML with `uv build` and `uv publish`, and shebang-driven scripts run unattended. missing for 10: documented CI guidance beyond GitHub Actions (other CI providers), explicit evidence on non-interactive and machine-readable output across most commands.
